scope: Resolve two separately indexed 2012 research articles by substantially the same author team, separating work/date/method claims before treating them as historical evidence. This is NOT an original-folio recovery.

direct_public_kci_records.title: 조선 초 간행의 교식가령(交食假令) 연구
direct_public_kci_records.bibliographic_scope: Comparative study of 七政算內篇丁卯年交食假令 and 交食推步法假令; the abstract dates the two historical publication stages to 1444 and 1458, while 丁卯/1447 is the worked eclipse-example year, not a third proven impression date.
direct_public_kci_records.technical_abstract_scope: Focuses on eclipse calculation, 加減差 and effects of true new/full-moon timing; says revised methods were introduced from China after 七政算內篇 and investigated/revised by Joseon astronomers. Without the article's complete text, do not decide which exact algorithm components were imported, independently recomposed or invented.

direct_public_kci_records.title: 『교식추보법가령』 연구
direct_public_kci_records.bibliographic_scope: Separate paper in the later 2012 issue; not an alternate URL, edition or duplicate original leaf of the preceding paper.
direct_public_kci_records.technical_abstract_scope: Reports six domains: solar 盈縮差, lunar 遲疾差, eclipse 加減差, sunrise/sunset time, corrected eclipse-maximum motion, red/yellow-way lunar mansion positions; discusses a formula with relative solar/lunar angular speed in 加減差 and reduced reliance on tabular 立成.

three_separate_calendar_roles.1444: Reported original 七政算內篇 compilation/publication stage in secondary scholarship; also distinct from 交食推步法假令 original copy
three_separate_calendar_roles.1447: 丁卯 worked eclipse-example year, NOT by itself the source impression year
three_separate_calendar_roles.1458: KCI scholarship's stated printing/publication year for later 交食推步法假令; the established AKS 1459 claim and SNU print-type differences still require physical original confirmation

comparison.interpretive_tension: April paper describes a post-1444 method introduced from China then revised locally; September paper describes newly devised calculations by Joseon mathematicians. These need exact formula-level primary-text comparison before asserting contradiction, sole Chinese origin or wholly autonomous Korean invention.
comparison.mechanical_guard: A later table-free calculation method may preserve an inherited numeric mathematical structure without proving literal identity of the earlier G893 table, its 少/微 units, rounding, columns or physical transmission. Secondary abstract claims cannot resolve GK00067 original 盈縮加分 folios.

prior_research_deduplication: 13OM already mentions KCI 2012 scholarship and SNU1458/AKS1459 tension; do not call 1458 or general existence of studies a new finding.
13OE already records KCI ART001701755 as a scholarly control. New here is the precise independent ART001656319 bibliographic record and the bounded two-article/work/year/computation crosswalk.
13OD and 13OV already did modern received-text arithmetic; do not repeat it or infer G893 original radix.
next_source_gate: Seek only new, no-fee provider-issued original specific 奎貴67 交食推步法 盈縮加分 upper/lower folio or independent primary precision/carry/field witness for 奎貴893/G893. The 2012 article abstracts are bibliography, not a substitute.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: An identical author team and similar article names do not turn two 2012 articles into two ancient physical witnesses.
No single direct China→Joseon or Joseon-only invention edge is established by either secondary abstract.
Shared numeric morphology or table-free arithmetic does not establish literal G893→GK00067 copy or field/radix identity.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Exact text and folio of SNU 奎貴67 盈縮加分 original
G893 少/微 radix and source-native carry/rounding
Formula-specific chronology of imported methods versus local revisions
